title: HtmlSup
responsibility: Renders the native sup element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlSup.attributes
inputs.description: Native sup attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlSup.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native sup element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlSup
outputs.description: The actual native sup element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
